title: The canonical proper forget-supports comparison with ordinary endpoints
statement: For a commutative ring A and a proper scheme morphism f:X -> Y, define ordinaryProperForgetComparison A f : Rf_! ->~ ordinaryFinitePushforward A f to be exactly the existing canonical rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat A) f, with the ordinary direct-image endpoint recorded before taking components. It has the same hom, inverse and inverse identities; no object, inverse or new comparison is selected.
